name: Nagano Asami
source:
Her work attitude is highly motivated and earnest, and her reputation at the company is so high that some people say she will soon be a manager!

However, she has been an honor student since childhood, and her life style of being depended on by those around her has left her with a pent-up feeling of depression, and she has developed a desire to do things she would not normally do to refresh her mind.

She has never had a good love life in the past, partly because she has always been a serious and modest woman, and partly because she has always resisted the idea of indulging in pleasure to the fullest extent of her desires.

Now she has no connection to the opposite sex, and spends her unfulfilled days indulging in extreme sexual fantasies while masturbating, which she has somehow learned to do....

[From [url=http://www.cyberworks.jp/wendybell/circle/Character&CG.html]official site[/url]]
